# dsh-web-search-searxng

> A DeepSeek Harness web-search provider backed by a SearXNG instance. No API key, no vendor account, and nothing for the plugin to store.

`@softspark/dsh-web-search-searxng` registers one search provider on the harness `ctx.web` seam, id `searxng`, and moves `web.searchProvider` onto it. The harness ships one search provider and it is gated on `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`; a key is an identity as much as a payment detail, and searching the web does not require one.

Apache-2.0. Unofficial and not affiliated with DeepSeek or the SearXNG project.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, configuration keys, what the bundle patch does, behaviour and failure modes
- [Set up an instance](kb/howto/setup.md): run SearXNG, enable the JSON output format it disables by default, point the plugin at it
- [Architecture](kb/reference/architecture.md): the web seam, provider selection rules, result mapping, boundaries
- [ADR-001: a search provider, not a key](kb/decisions/adr-001-provider-not-key.md): why the provider is replaced rather than the key supplied
- [Common issues](kb/troubleshooting/common-issues.md): a provider that is never selected, an instance answering HTML, searches that reach nothing
